description: Approves one or more SeoBriefs and AUTO-fires L4 article/comparison generation immediately — do NOT call seo_write_article after this. Typically takes ~3–8 min per article. After approval, poll each returned operationId with get_job until state is `completed` (or `failed`/`partially_failed`/`cancelled` on error). A brief in status `writing` means generation is already in progress — poll the existing operation, do not re-submit. Body: briefIds (array, max 200). Response: { approved, failed: [{briefId, reason}], operationIds, operations: [{briefId, operationId, type}] }.

generateHeroImage.description: Also generate a hero image per blog brief (extra credits).

name: seo_approve_briefs
